note: Established 0.6s lead and 0.95s gap, rounded up to whole frames. Persisted audio bytes and measured Whisper words drive playback; generation is never repeated during rendering. No approval is inferred from generation.

clips.script: From Home, tap the bottom Scan.
Point the scanner at the zone QR code. Check in to Premix Area.
Confirm Premix Area is unlocked. Inspect before recording a result.
To review scheduled work before checking in, open Bill of Health from Home.
Choose Cleaning Verification for missing scheduled checks. Remedial tracks open findings.
The starting point is two hundred and thirty-five still to do, with none captured. Open the area.
Before check-in, Due lists nineteen Daily checks. Completion is locked.
Open the linked SSOP for the item's inspection reference.
No photos are present. Viewing this reference records no check.
Off-schedule lists fourteen weekly items. Check the next due date. These items stay untouched here. Record only work actually done.
After check-in, inspect the item. If it meets the cleaning requirements, tap its green tick.
The pass saves inline, with a green status and Undo.
Progress is now one of nineteen.
Daily Pass all becomes eligible after that first inspection of the same frequency. Eighteen remain; record the exceptions first.
For a failed check, tap the red cross to open Remedial Action.
Choose the appropriate grade, Major here. Give the required failure reason. Action taken and a genuine photo are optional.
Submit. Task Completed confirms the capture. The due occurrence is recorded, while the finding remains open in Remedial and needs follow-up.
This separate Tables example is Critical. Submitting it raises an NCR.
The app confirms an NCR has been raised. Its linked record remains open.
For Mixing Bowls, choose Unavailable. Record why access was not possible and the next step, if useful.
Unavailable recorded confirms the access outcome. It is not a pass.
Now Pass all covers fifteen remaining Daily checks in Premix Area. The individual pass and three exceptions are excluded. Confirm only work checked clean.
Nineteen completed includes sixteen passes, two failures and one unavailable. Tables shows NCR raised; the findings stay open.
Still to do is two hundred and sixteen. Passed is sixteen; follow-up owed is two; couldn't access is one. Nineteen scheduled checks are captured.
Open Follow-ups and find the Cleaning finding. Review the reason, arrange the correction, and recheck.
After correction and recheck, select Confirm Followed Up to close the finding.
Add an optional note or genuine photo, then select the inner Confirm.
Blue Covers leaves the open queue. The search now has no matches.

Still to do stays at two hundred and sixteen. Passed stays sixteen; follow-up owed drops to one; couldn't access stays one. Blue Covers is resolved today. Its original fail and nineteen captured checks are unchanged.
That is the scheduled check and immediate follow-up loop. The Remedial video explains persistent findings and Inspection Remedials that carry over.

evidence.evidenceLimit: The saved sanitized log establishes the reported provider error and the script establishes the stop path. No raw transcription response, transcription request ID or billing-project identity was retained; billing history and current balance cannot be established from this log.
evidence.diagnosticIfStillBlocked: Identify the effective OPENAI_API_KEY project and check its credit/billing state. In a separately authorized transcription-only retry of the retained home MP3, capture sanitized HTTP status, error code and request ID without logging credentials.
